data.description:
Lead Product Designer

📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

💰 £70k-£90k (negotiable)

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer - the most senior individual contributor for design within a product domain. This is predominantly an IC role: you'll set the design bar for an entire domain through the quality of your own work, the patterns you contribute, and the way you raise the designers around you. We're flexible on this for the right person, if you've got management experience, or want to line-manage one or two designers alongside the IC work, let's talk.

We want someone who is tired of the "feature factory" grind, who is past needing to be told what's worth working on, and who is ready to set the design direction for a domain in one of the most exciting PropTech companies in the UK.

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. Lead Product Designers drive roadmap conversations alongside their product and engineering counterparts, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L6 Lead Product Designer at Street Group

  • Own the design vision and execution for a product domain. Translate strategic direction into the most ambiguous, cross-cutting, or strategically important pieces of design work.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like in your area.

  • Own the cross-cutting design problems: patterns across multiple features, flows across multiple surfaces, the coherence of the domain's experience as a whole.

  • Mentor and raise the bar of the designers around you - through critique, pairing, and modelling what excellent design looks like.

  • Drive AI thinking strategically - both in your own workflow (Claude Code, in-product changes, prototype testing) and in what we ship to users. You'll have a strong view on what makes a good AI feature in this domain vs a gimmicky one.

Why you should (and shouldn't) apply

You should apply if:

  • You've operated at senior IC level in a modern product org and you want broader scope to influence what gets built.

  • You're commercially fluent. You've made design trade-offs informed by how the product makes money, not just by user preference. You can name those trade-offs and defend them either way.

  • You define what success looks like before you ship, and you read the result against it after. Metrics, support data, customer feedback - you go and look.

  • You have strong, well-formed views on AI in product design and have put them into practice. You can articulate when AI is the right design solution and when it isn't.

  • You move at pace on strategic work, not just on features.

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role. Lead expects materially more scope, autonomy, judgment, and ownership of outcomes.

  • You've never shipped design work where you defined a success measure upfront and checked the result afterwards. We need someone who already operates that way.

  • You've never had to make a commercial trade-off - design that's user-optimal but expensive to build, or design that doesn't move retention.

  • You'd struggle to explain how AI is changing what you ship, not just how you work. AI fluency is non-negotiable at this level.

  • You expect to be handed a brief. At L6 you identify what's worth doing and bring the case for it.

A bit about you

  • Experience: Roughly 8+ years of Product/UX Design experience, with a track record at senior IC level. SaaS or complex product experience is strongly preferred.

  • Outcomes, not artefacts: You can point to design work you've shipped where you wrote the success measure upfront and read the result after release. You know what worked, what didn't, and what you'd do differently.

  • Commercial fluency: You understand how the products you've worked on make money and you've made trade-offs informed by that.

  • AI: Comfortable using AI across your workflow and equally comfortable thinking strategically about AI in the products you design - what makes a good AI feature, what the failure modes are, what to build now vs later.

  • Craft: Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach. You have views on interaction quality, hierarchy, motion, microcopy - and you can defend them.

  • Cross-functional: Comfortable as a peer at the table with product and engineering counterparts in your domain. Drive direction; don't wait for it.

  • Open to flex: This is predominantly an IC role, but we're not rigid about it. If you've line-managed before, or want to take on one or two direct reports alongside the IC work, we're open to that conversation.

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week

🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

About Legal 500

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

About the Role:

Our new AI Product Owner will provide central product ownership for AI capabilities developed and used across Legal 500, spanning multiple business units, functions and AI products.

We see the primary premise of this role is to ensure that investment in AI is prioritised against Legal 500’s business objectives, that products solve clearly defined business problems, and that appropriate quality, governance, human oversight and accountability are built into their lifecycle.

What you'll do:

You will have the opportunity to operate as centrally within Legal 500, sitting within the 'Project' unit within our People & Business Operations function. You'll work across business-unit leaders, users, Technology, Data, Governance and relevant technology partners or suppliers.

You'll be accountable for maintaining an enterprise AI product portfolio and roadmap and have responsibility for translating business needs into prioritised product requirements. This role is also about overseeing adoption and value realisation and ensuring AI products continue to improve as Legal 500’s operating models evolve. There is a possibility we may grow this team out to support on AI-specific engineering tasks.

What we're looking for:

Essential

  • Strong product ownership background, ideally managing a portfolio of products or initiatives across multiple functions in an AI, data, digital or knowledge-intensive environment in a business change context

  • Good understanding of how generative AI and related technologies can be applied to business processes (this role is not about having deep engineering expertise)

  • Ability to quickly understand different business functions and complex processes, and translate them into clear product requirements, priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to challenge AI outputs and understand issues such as hallucination, bias, confidence and evidence quality

  • Experience working across multiple business units and technology teams, balancing competing priorities and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Curious and comfortable challenging established ways of working with a commercial and outcome-focused approach rather than technology-led

  • Comfortable working in an evolving environment where AI capabilities and operating practices will continue to change.

Desirable

  • An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets, research or other knowledge-intensive environments would be advantageous.

Role information:

  • Hybrid workplace - 3 days a week in office, 2 days remote

  • This role can be based in either London or Leeds

  • Occasional travel to the other offices may be required (Bristol, London and Leeds)

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Growth is a critical function at Allica, sitting at the intersection of marketing, product, sales, and data. Our team is responsible for driving sustainable and scalable customer acquisition, engagement, and retention—ensuring our banking solutions reach and resonate with the right SMEs at the right time. Growth is both a science and an art. We blend commercial strategy with deep customer understanding, leveraging data to uncover new opportunities while ensuring every touchpoint aligns with Allica’s mission to empower established SMEs with the banking they deserve.

Role Description

The Growth Manager will play a key role in driving effective and sustainable growth across Allica's BRA customer journey — from onboarding through account activation and into deeper, embedded product usage. This role focuses on understanding customer behaviour end-to-end, identifying where customers stall or disengage, and building the strategies and capabilities needed to move them forward.

Using a data-driven approach, the Growth Manager will lead the design and delivery of initiatives that improve activation, engagement, and long-term customer value — often working with limited precedent and translating diagnosis into tools, frameworks, and ways of working that the wider business relies on. They will build alignment across marketing, product, sales, RM, and data teams, ensuring growth strategy is coherently applied across the customer journey.

This role is ideal for someone with strong applied critical thinking, a track record of leading initiatives with real ambiguity, and the ability to build stakeholder alignment without formal authority over the teams they influence.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Customer Behaviour & Cohort Analysis: Lead analysis of customer behaviour, lifecycle stages, and cohorts to identify key drivers of activation, engagement, and product usage, delving into complex problems to reach root-cause understanding rather than surface patterns.

  • Data-Driven Insights & Strategic Recommendations: Own the growth and engagement metrics that matter most for the customer journey, translating insight into strategy that shapes how the team and wider business operate.

  • Experimentation & Optimisation: Manage a robust experimentation pipeline, designing, prioritising, and overseeing tests across initiatives to ensure impactful, evidence-based decisions rather than one-off analysis.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment: Build alignment across departments; marketing, product, sales, RM, and data, managing differing stakeholder expectations to keep initiatives progressing.

  • Framework & Capability Building: Take diagnosed problems through to operational reality, building the tools, scoring frameworks, and processes that other teams adopt and rely on.

  • Leadership & Ownership: Manage multiple objectives concurrently, ensuring accountability for outcomes even where the path forward isn't well precedented.

  • Communication: Design and deliver insightful, visually compelling presentations that influence decision-making and align stakeholders on growth strategy

Personal attributes & Experience

  • Experience working in hypothesis-led, problem-solving environments (e.g. high-growth start-ups, consulting or similar) is a plus.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and navigate complex, ambiguous problems using structured thinking.

  • Comfortable working with technical systems and integrations (e.g. CRM, analytics tools, automation platforms) to improve efficiency and scale.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Customer

What we do: build an AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏠 Where you’ll fit in: The Delivery Team

We have been licensing Kraken since 2019. Throughout this time, the Delivery team has been at the forefront of industry-leading migrations, setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. These transformations go far beyond technology: we work with clients to rethink their operating models and ways of working, while continuously making the most of Kraken's evolving capabilities.

Client Delivery sits at the heart of Kraken’s transformation journeys, at the intersection of our clients and the product and engineering teams building Kraken 🚀 We lead conversations around our clients’ most important needs, help them unlock the value of Kraken and turn complex challenges into opportunities to evolve the platform, keeping Kraken innovative, relevant and ahead of where the energy market is going.

It’s a high-impact, hands-on team where you’ll influence both our clients transformation and what Kraken becomes next 💡 As a Global Practice Lead, you’ll shape and lead your practice globally, working closely with Regional Practice Leads in your team across EMEA, the US and APAC to set the global direction for the practice, drive consistency and excellence across regions, and bring together insights from our people, clients and markets to influence how we deliver and how Kraken evolves.

 

🚀 What you'll own

As a Global Practice Lead at Kraken, you will set the global direction for your practice and be accountable for its performance, capability and evolution across regions. You will lead and develop Regional Practice Leads and their teams, ensuring that Kraken delivers consistently high standards for clients globally while adapting to different markets and client needs.

  • Global TTV & Transformation Outcomes: Drive improvements in Time to Value and client outcomes across the global portfolio, using insights across migrations and BAU engagements to continuously improve how Kraken delivers.

  • Global Capacity & Workforce Strategy: Own the long-term capability and capacity strategy for the practice, partnering with regional leaders and Talent to anticipate demand, identify skills gaps and ensure the right expertise is available in the right markets.

  • Executive Client Engagement: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders globally and step into the most strategic or complex engagements where senior leadership, alignment or intervention is required.

  • Strategic Escalation & Decision-Making: Act as a senior escalation point for complex, cross-regional challenges, bringing together the right stakeholders and removing organizational, product or delivery blockers.

  • Practice Expertise & Standards: Define what excellence looks like within your practice, establishing global methodologies, standards and best practices while allowing appropriate flexibility for regional and client-specific needs.

  • Organizational Influence: Partner with senior leaders across Delivery, Product, Engineering and other functions to shape decisions that affect clients, delivery strategy and the future development of the practice.

  • Cross-Regional Learning & Scale: Ensure knowledge, successful delivery patterns and lessons learned move effectively across regions, turning individual client experiences into improvements that benefit Kraken globally.

  • Future Capability: Anticipate how the practice needs to evolve as Kraken, our product and the energy industry develop, building new capabilities and expertise ahead of emerging client needs.

     

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • People-first leadership: A leadership style grounded in influence, trust and leading by example rather than authority, with a genuine commitment to caring for and developing people. The ability to create psychological safety and combine empathy with clear expectations and accountability, enabling teams to feel trusted, supported and empowered to do their best work.

  • Senior global leadership experience: Significant experience leading complex client delivery, transformation or professional-services organizations across multiple regions, clients and markets.

  • Leadership of leaders: experience leading and developing other leaders, with the ability to create clarity and accountability while empowering regional leadership teams to make effective decisions.

  • Strategic influence: A demonstrated ability to operate at senior leadership level and influence strategy across organizational boundaries, particularly across Delivery, Product and Engineering.

  • Executive client leadership: Credibility with C-level and senior client stakeholders, including experience navigating complex transformations, competing priorities and high-stakes client situations.

  • Subject-matter expertise: Deep expertise in your practice area, combined with a strong understanding of the global energy landscape and the ability to recognize where regional differences require different approaches.

  • Systems thinking: The ability to look across regions and client engagements, identify patterns and root causes, and turn those insights into scalable improvements to products, processes and ways of working.

  • Strategic & operational balance: The ability to set long-term direction while remaining close enough to delivery to understand what is happening on the ground and intervene effectively when required.

  • People leadership & emotional intelligence: Sound judgment and empathy, with experience developing senior talent, navigating difficult conversations and creating environments where leaders and teams can perform at their best.

  • Communication & executive presence: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, create compelling narratives and align senior internal and external stakeholders around a common direction.

  • Resilience & adaptability: The resilience, pragmatism and hands-on mindset to navigate ambiguity and significant transformation, while keeping teams aligned and moving forward.

data.description:
Rejoins Fastned pour accélérer la transition énergétique ! En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

  • Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide.

  • Analyser les nouveaux sites et monter les dossiers, d’un point de vue économique et juridique.

  • Nouer des relations commerciales avec divers types de propriétaires fonciers.

  • Négocier et conclure des contrats de bail.

  • Suivre et coordonner le développement des projets, de la signature des accords jusqu'à l’ouverture des stations.

  • Coordonner avec les services internes le bon déroulement des projets.

  • Cultiver et développer ton réseau, représenter Fastned lors d’évènements extérieurs.

Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ?

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Ce que nous recherchons

Tu aimes prendre des initiatives, tu n’as pas peur de faire des erreurs et tu as soif d’apprendre ? Si tu coches également les cases suivantes, alors postule ! 

  • Tu vis dans la région parisienne et tu y as déjà un réseau conséquent;

  • Tu as +3 ans d’expérience en développement immobilier ou d’enseignes ;

  • Tu es intéressé.e/animé.e par la transition énergétique ;

  • Tu as le contact facile, capable de nouer des relations durables ;

  • Tu as l’habitude de prendre la voiture pour visiter un site en pleine campagne et le train pour venir au bureau à Paris régulièrement ;

  • Tu as de solides compétences en matière de négociation et de communication ;

  • Tu comprends et sais t’exprimer en anglais ;

  • Tu as un permis de conduire valide afin de monter à bord de ta voiture de fonction électrique et voir nos beaux projets se concrétiser partout en France !

Nos avantages

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly.

Nos avantages :

  • Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies.

  • Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts.

  • Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour. 

  • 25 jours de congés + RTT + 2 jours de Mission Days que tu peux utiliser pour contribuer aux missions de Fastned et soutenir une cause associative qui te tient à cœur.

  • Fastned prend en charge 60 % de ta mutuelle Alan et 100 % de ton salaire pendant les 30 premiers jours d’absence pour maladie/incapacité de travail.

  • Un abonnement Gymlib avec accès à un large réseau de salles de sport et studios.

  • Plan de stock options -> nous croyons à la création de valeur partagée.

  • Bien-être mental avec nilo health : accès à une plateforme de santé mentale confidentielle offrant des séances de coaching individuel avec des psychologues, des sessions de groupe et une variété d’outils.

  • Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites.

Envie d'en savoir plus ?

On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi.

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en 4 étapes :

  • Entretien vidéo avec notre recruteuse ;

  • Entretien vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France et un Expansion Manager

  • Case study vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France, et deux membres de l’équipe ;

  • Team coffee chats dans nos locaux parisiens pour rencontrer les collègues de l’équipe France.

Nous attendons ta candidature ! Si tu as des questions ou que tu as besoin de plus d'informations concernant ta candidature, veuillez contacter notre équipe de recrutement via ----- style="text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;">

Fastned est synonyme d'équité et d'inclusion. Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, identités de genre, orientations sexuelles, religions, neurodiversités, handicaps, situations familiales ou toute autre caractéristique protégée qui te rend unique.

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

The Role

Right now our factories are floor plans, early equipment, and a handful of people who've done this before. In a few years they need to produce aircraft at rate. You'll help find everyone in between.

You'll be a core part of our manufacturing hiring across two sites: our Oxnard HQ and a new facility in Northwest Arkansas. Early on, that means landing the few people who set the foundation. Later, it means scaling fast without lowering the bar. When manufacturing hiring is lighter, you'll flex to support other teams across the company, so you'll never be short on work or on range.


The Work

  • Own full-cycle hiring across manufacturing, industrial, quality, tooling, and production roles at both sites, from technicians on the floor to the leaders running them

  • Learn manufacturing well enough to follow a layout review. Composites, tooling, process development, and factory ramp: you should know what good looks like

  • Recruit from where the talent actually is. Automotive, EV, consumer hardware, and high-rate industrial manufacturing are often better sources for us than legacy aerospace

  • Build our Northwest Arkansas talent pipeline from zero: schools, trade programs, local manufacturers, veteran networks, and community partners

  • Hire ahead of the scale-up. Build relationships today with people we may not hire for two years

  • Flex to support aircraft, supply chain, operations, and other teams when manufacturing volume allows. Manufacturing always comes first

You

  • Have [4+] years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with meaningful time recruiting for manufacturing, production, or hardware teams

  • Know the difference between a manufacturing engineer and an industrial engineer without looking it up

  • Have hired through a factory launch, production ramp, or high-growth hardware environment and liked the pace

  • Can run hiring in two very different markets without either one feeling like the afterthought

  • Would rather source a composites tech out of a boat builder than wait for an applicant

Bonus Points

  • Recruiting experience at an EV, automotive, aerospace, or hardware company during a plant launch or ramp

  • Experience hiring hourly and skilled trades at volume alongside engineering roles

  • Familiarity with the Northwest Arkansas or Midwest manufacturing talent market

  • Supply chain or operations recruiting experience

Why This Seat

You get to build the hiring engine for a factory before it exists, at a company where manufacturing is the whole ballgame.


How We Recruit

We're a small recruiting team building a defense company that has to win. Here's how we operate, and we hire recruiters who already work this way.

The Standard. We know the work deeply. We are not generalists hiding behind job descriptions; we study the engineering, the domain, and the landscape until we can hold a real conversation with a practitioner. Every candidate who talks to us should call it the best recruiting experience of their career, and we each bring our own personality to get there. High touch, never scripted.

How We Think. One foot old school, one foot forward: we're obsessive about the fundamentals of recruiting and restless about finding better ways to do it. We play the long game and hire for what someone will do in two and five years, not just next quarter. And we'd rather define the industry standard than follow it.

How We Operate. Mission first, always. Speed is a competitive weapon, and we use it. Quality over comfort: we'll have the harder conversation with a hiring manager before we'll make the easy hire.

If that reads like a description of how you already work, we want to talk.

data.description:
About Genesis

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake.

We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.

The role

General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too.

You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area.

You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not just run existing tasks: you will help shape how they are executed, how quality is measured, and how other operators are trained to deliver consistently.

What you will do

  • Help lead the Paris data collection floor. Set the execution and quality bar for day-to-day collection work and help the team scale effectively.

  • Own complex collection setups. Take a loosely defined request and turn it into a working, repeatable collection task, including the setup, fixtures, props, environment, and procedure, with minimal support from engineering.

  • Create high-quality training data. Wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and produce precise demonstrations that can be used to train our models.

  • Own the full collection workflow. Go beyond collecting the data itself: review and quality-check your work, identify unusable episodes, support annotation, and help ensure that what reaches research is trainable data.

  • Build repeatable tasks. Turn new collection requests into clear, repeatable processes that can be executed consistently by other operators.

  • Partner with research and model engineering. Translate their requests into physical collection tasks, share observations from the floor, and iterate with them on setups and collection strategy.

  • Improve the operation. Identify when a fixture, station layout, procedure, or collection method can be improved and proactively help implement those improvements.

  • Write and improve the playbook. Own SOPs, quality checks, and training materials that allow the Paris operation to scale while maintaining a consistent quality bar.

  • Guide other operators. Help onboard, train, and mentor operators and reinforce consistent execution across the team.

  • Run real-robot testing. Partner with reliability and engineering teams to test robots on the floor, document what you observe, and help surface issues.

  • Own quality. Review your own work and the team's, take direct feedback, and keep raising the bar.

What we are looking for

  • You have done precise, repetitive physical work to a high quality bar and can explain what made your work good and how you measured it. This could include data collection, teleoperation, motion capture, robotics lab work, assembly, fine craft, or another hands-on technical environment.

  • Hands-on robot or glove-based data collection experience is a strong plus, but not a requirement. This kind of data collection is new, and we will teach you our specific tools and approach.

  • You build, not just run. Give you a vague request and a scrappy setup, and you can turn it into a clean, repeatable task with the right fixtures, environment, process, and written procedure.

  • You can operate autonomously. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex collection tasks with limited day-to-day support from engineering.

  • You understand quality beyond collection. You can review your work, recognize when collected data is unusable or below the quality bar, and understand why.

  • You are ready to lead. You have trained, mentored, or led others doing hands-on work and want to help establish the execution and quality standard for a growing team.

  • You work well with research and engineering teams. You can translate their requests into physical collection tasks and turn what you observe during collection into useful feedback.

  • You have exceptional attention to detail. You notice the moment something about the setup, hardware, environment, procedure, or collected data is off.

  • You are technically handy. You are comfortable with Linux, some Python scripting to automate repetitive work, and hardware assembly and troubleshooting.

  • You are comfortable in a fast-moving environment. Hardware, processes, and collection methods will evolve quickly, and you are comfortable adapting while helping improve how the team works.

  • You communicate well in English. You will work daily with teams in Paris and the Bay Area across time zones. French is a plus.

  • Bonus: reliability testing. You have partnered with a reliability or test team on real-robot testing.

Working conditions and role constraints

  • Work takes place in production environments and technical laboratories.

  • Prolonged standing and repetitive hand and arm movements while wearing collection equipment, including gloves, head-mounted cameras, and headsets, for extended periods.

  • Handling and lifting of loads, including props, fixtures, robot equipment, and station equipment, up to 23 kg for station setup and reconfiguration.

Why this role

  • Real ownership. You will have meaningful ownership over how the Paris data collection floor operates and help set the standard the team grows toward.

  • Hands-on leadership. You will remain close to the work while helping guide other operators, improve execution, and raise the quality bar.

  • Build, not just execute. You will take ambiguous collection needs and turn them into reliable, repeatable tasks that can scale across the team.

  • A clear growth path. As the operation scales, this role can grow toward leading or supervising teams of operators or toward broader project and program management responsibilities.

  • The front line of the mission. The data you create, review, and improve is what teaches our robots to work.

TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

 

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.
  • Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage.
  • You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume.
  • Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built.


Why us?

LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification.

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it.

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like.

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market.

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional.

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line. 

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

Mission

As a Lead Product Manager on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles: core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
  • Own LiveOps end-to-end. You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
  • Lead your team. You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
  • Oversee the monetization model. Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
  • Drive growth, in partnership with UA. You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
  • Cross-functional excellence. You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
  • Set the bar. Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
  • Stay hands-on when it counts. This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.

This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

Requirements

We are looking for someone with several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG, with genuine end-to-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

Product & RPG expertise

  • Product experience on live F2P mobile games, ideally RPG/midcore, with end-to-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
  • Strong fluency in RPG mechanics and meta systems: progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
  • Ideally, you’ve taken a title from concept/pre-launch through launch and LiveOps, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

LiveOps & Execution

  • Deep LiveOps experience, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
  • Strong track record owning features end-to-end: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of what a live team can realistically ship and maintain, balancing ambition with feasibility.

Leadership & Ways of working

  • Strong cross-functional leadership, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
  • A strategist and builder: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands-on with the game, systems and data.
  • Thrives in lean, fast-moving, high-autonomy teams with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership

Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough.”
  • Humility: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we dive deep into the details.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: this is one remote position open to multiple countries, not multiple openings.

About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK or Germany.

Please submit your CV in English

About the role:

As a Computational Biologist at Owkin, you will have a unique opportunity to contribute to the discovery of better treatments through the development and use of agentic AI systems. An integral member of the Biomedical team, you will work alongside world-class experts in AI and biology within a multidisciplinary team dedicated to pioneering discoveries, all while embedded in an organization that develops end-to-end AI systems for clients. Your experience in omics will allow you to contribute to the building of our AI Scientist, an agentic system designed to navigate the complexities of target and drug discovery.

 

In particular, you will:

  • Contribute analyses to projects aiming to discover novel drug targets, biomarkers and disease subtypes through reverse translation based on multi-omics patient or pre-clinical data including: genomic, transcriptomic (spatial, single-cell, bulk), proteomic, and others.

  • analyze biomedical datasets using classical or novel omics methods and machine / deep learning algorithms

  • Conduct literature reviews to stay up-to-date with respect to relevant approaches and datasets

  • Participate in the interpretation of results and help design validation strategies together with cross-functional teams.

  • Collaborate with other members of Owkin’s R&Tech and Biomedical departments with varied backgrounds (computational biologists and chemists, AI scientists, medical imaging experts, medical doctors, biologists, …).

  • Contribute analyses and visualisations to generate scientific internal and external communications and reports.

  • Participate in Owkin’s internal R&D activities, develop new as well as improve existing methodologies, strive to keep Owkin’s Toolbox to the state-of-the-art.

  

About you

The successful candidate will have a ‘team-first’ kind of attitude; be curious and detail-attentive; thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment; and be fun to work with.

And:

  • Be passionate about the potential for impact when combining AI and healthcare.

  • MSc / PhD in either computational biology, bioinformatics, biology, machine learning, computer science, mathematics or a related field.

  • Experience working with omics data and NGS data processing pipelines.

  • Experience of integrating multi-omics datasets.

  • Experience of working in early-stage drug discovery programs, and with tasks such as target identification, biomarker discovery and patient stratification.

  • Good knowledge about molecular and cellular biology, especially related to cancer and/or other human diseases, to help interpret analyzis results together with our biomedical experts.

  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts and toolkits such as: cross validation, statistical tests, scikit learn, xgboost, etc.

  • Experience using autonomous AI agents and agentic workflows to perform data analyses.

  • Good programming skills in Python.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

 

Ways to Stand Out

The following experience is not necessarily required, but would be a plus:

  • Single-cell RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomic data analysis.

  • Clinical and biomedical imaging data.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems and their development.

  • History of publications or contributions to top-tier academic journals or conferences.

  • Have previously worked in a biotech / pharma / life science company.

 

 #LI-HB1

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization

  • Friendly and informal working environment

  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn and Job Teaser, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

  • Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

    • [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/

    • [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime

    • [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

About the team

The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior.

This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows.

Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software.

  • Design and lead technical talks, live demos, workshops, hackathons, and repeatable hands-on programmes that turn initial interest into sustained adoption.

  • Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability.

  • Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform.

  • Collaborate with account teams, developer experience, and ecosystem partners to reach developers and founders, prioritise opportunities, and drive measurable customer value.

  • Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved.

  • Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy building practical AI applications, integrations, and developer tools.

  • Are an active user of Codex or other AI coding tools, with a thoughtful perspective on how they can improve software development.

  • Are a compelling communicator who enjoys presenting, delivering live demos, and leading hands-on workshops for developers and founders.

  • Have a talent for turning complex technical ideas into clear explanations, engaging examples, and reusable resources that help others succeed.

  • Combine developer empathy with sound technical judgment: you can uncover what a team needs, troubleshoot problems, and help them adopt effective, reliable workflows.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.

  • Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.

  • Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

Who we're looking for

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. 🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on, globally experienced People leader and builder to help take Filigran’s People organization through its next stage of scale.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you’ll lead our global People Operations, Payroll and Total Rewards capabilities across Europe, North America and APJ.

With ~300 employees across 18 countries, the challenge is not simply to build more People infrastructure — it’s to build smarter infrastructure. You’ll help create a scalable, technology- and AI-first People operating model that combines strong regional execution with effective systems, automation, and agentic AI.

This is a builder and player-coach role. You’ll be expected to challenge how work gets done, simplify before adding complexity, automate before adding headcount, and build the People capabilities needed to support Filigran’s next stage of growth.

  • Support managers on routine performance, employee relations, workforce matters and organizational change.

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

We own the whole offer lifecycle for several kind of services (health insurance, life & disability insurance, employee benefits) across 4 countries. We manage an incredible business complexity and diversity in a scalable way, and most importantly, we empower others to act autonomously on it:

  • 🌍 One insurance stack for every country. We're replacing country-by-country code with a shared "Core Stack": one set of shared rules, with room for local differences.   • 🤖 AI-native underwriting. Insurance is complex, and most insurers need actuaries on every quote. We empower our Sales to build compliant and relevant offers themselves in minutes. AI-assisted smart alternatives, price explanations, pitching and more are already in the Sales hands, and there’s much more to build.

  • 🛡️ Life & Disability as a first-class product: We’re bringing this historically smaller product at Alan to the same level of maturity as Health, with first class member XP, Ops and enabling access to a much wider population.
