About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

What would you be doing?

  • Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it

  • Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great

  • Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand

  • Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts

  • Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does

  • Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment

  • Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows

  • Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts

  • Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top

  • Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand

  • Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned

  • Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it

What do we need from you?

  • Significant experience leading marketing in B2B SMB - selling to owner-operators and small businesses, not enterprise procurement committees. You understand that a high-volume, lower-ACV motion is a fundamentally different sport

  • A track record of building marketing teams and functions from the ground up. You've been the first or second marketing leader, hired the team, chosen the stack and created the operating model. Maintaining someone else's machine is not what you're looking for

  • Deep, hands-on data and growth orientation. You build growth models, instrument funnels, run experiments with real statistical discipline, and can talk fluently about CAC, payback, conversion by stage and cohort behaviour. You're as comfortable in the numbers as you are in the narrative

  • Demonstrated ownership of a pipeline or revenue number, with the receipts — you can walk us through what you inherited, what you changed, and what it did to the funnel

  • Full-stack breadth: you've owned some combination of performance, content, product marketing, lifecycle and brand, and you know which of them matters most right now versus in eighteen months

  • Genuine senior leadership: you've hired, managed managers, made hard calls on people and priorities, and held your own with a founder, CEO or board

  • The judgement to say no. You can name the channels you deliberately didn't pursue and explain why, anchored to the company's go-to-market model

  • Comfort with ambiguity and low hierarchy. You're happy to write the ad copy yourself one week and present the three-year growth model the next

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to operate across time zones in a globally distributed team

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, where supply and demand have to be grown in step

  • Background in a traditional, offline-heavy industry going through digital transformation — jewellery, construction, logistics, food service, wholesale, agriculture

  • Experience in a company that scaled from roughly $10M to $100M+ in GMV or revenue

  • International go-to-market experience across multiple regions and languages

  • Familiarity with a modern growth stack — HubSpot, Mixpanel or similar product analytics, and a warehouse-backed reporting setup

Our culture and what we offer 🌍

We're collaborative, fast-moving and allergic to bureaucracy. We're growing exponentially, which means real ownership and real scope — the work you do here is visible, and it compounds. We hire people who want to get better, give them the context to make good decisions, and then get out of the way.

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🏥 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and continuous learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 📈 The chance to join a company in its exponential expansion phase

  9. Swiss German is the preferred default language for this role; fluency in both Swiss German and French is a strong plus given Switzerland's multilingual market. Strong English is also required for internal collaboration.

About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: Remote

The impact you will have:

Notabene is moving up-market. Our growth now comes from financial institutions and fintechs launching digital asset products. These are bigger customers with longer implementation cycles, more stakeholders and higher contract values than the crypto-native exchanges we grew up with.

You will own a small number of these customers. Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them.

Growth is the part of this role that matters most. One signed contract is a way into the rest of the organisation. You will map it, find the other teams, entities and regions that need us, and work with Sales to open them.

You are also the technical point of contact for your customers. Enterprise conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful without a Solutions Engineer in the room. Comfort with APIs and the curiosity to work things out yourself matter more here than an engineering background.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and close new, complex opportunities, engage with technical and nontechnical stakeholders to accelerate the sales process. Understand and align with each customer's product, business, and compliance roadmap to uncover opportunities for Notabene to accelerate their progress against it

  • Over time hire, help provide input and hire 1-2 additional Solutions Architecture team, and be a vocal advocate for the SA function across the organization.

  • Recommend and develop systems and processes for the Solutions Architecture team that can be used to fit into the broader pre-sales GTM team and strategy, including but not limited to proposing metrics to measure the performance and impact of the Solutions Architecture team

  • Support in the design and development of exemplary POC and act as the escalation point for pre-sales technical issues

  • Align with GTM leaders to spot market trends and channel those insights back to Notabene's leadership and product teams

  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing and other teams such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and Product Engineering, to build joint go-to-market initiatives that improve customer outcomes, driving revenue and growth

  • Bring strong executive engagement skills and presence, establishing credible relationships with prospects’ decision-makers

  • Maintain strong internal relationships with Product and Engineering, championing the voice of our customers and their compliance teams to influence roadmap direction and feature priorities

Qualifications

  • 2+ year of pre-sales leadership experience, with a proven ability to build, coach, and retain high-performing teams;

  • 5+ years across technical sales, consulting, implementation, or go-to-market functions;

  • A track record of building and leading world-class Solutions Architecture/Sales Engineering/Solutions Engineering teams, ideally in a SaaS business

  • Genuine energy, curiosity, and a passion for making customers successful, and creatively drafting solutions to address customers’ needs

  • Strong hands-on technical sales experience with APIs;

  • Knowledge of payments, crypto, fintech, or RegTech industry experience strongly preferred

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to build deep, credible relationships with our prospects and customers

data.description:
Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We are a fast-growing team driving massive impact in one of the largest and most under-served industries in the world.

We serve the world’s top manufacturers across the globe. From Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, our customers trust us to make their factories run better. We are backed by leading investors like Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Google, Meta, Palantir, MBB, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

What is this job about?

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of applied machine learning and software engineering, building and deploying computer vision systems in real-world environments.

You will design, train, evaluate, and debug machine learning models, taking solutions from early prototypes through to robust, production-ready deployments. A part of your work will involve curating high-quality datasets to support model performance and continuous improvement.

You will build and apply state-of-the-art vision models, staying up to date with the latest advancements and integrating new approaches where they add value.


First and foremost, we believe in curious people who are eager to learn and grow. If you’re passionate about cutting-edge tech and driving major impact in manufacturing, we want to hear from you. Please also reach out if you don’t check all the points mentioned here.

What do you need to succeed in this role?

Must-Haves:

  • Strong technical foundation in computer science with focus on computer vision (CV) and machine learning (ML), whether gained through formal education or substantial real-world experience

  • Solid understanding of core ML and CV concepts, including training dynamics, generalization, bias-variance tradeoffs, evaluation methodology, and common failure modes

  • Hands-on model training experience: able to set up training loops, debug convergence, tune hyperparameters, and evaluate properly on real CV tasks

  • Shipped a model or CV pipeline in a production or near-production environment with real users beyond a research or internal project.

  • Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English

  • Strong motivation to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

Bonus:

  • Expertise in visual quality, defect or anomaly detection

  • Experience in model deployment, such as ONNX, and MLOps basics

  • Experience in visualization of model internals and explainability

Why is Ethon right for you?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here at least three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person.

Feedback loops are short. Access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here grow fast and take on real responsibility.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We’re committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

🍇 Über grape:
 
Unser unternehmerischer Geist treibt uns an bei dem, was wir bewegen und wofür wir brennen. Unsere Mission ist, der führende Gesundheitspartner in der Versicherungsbranche zu werden. Wir haben den Innovations bedarf im traditionellen Versicherungsmodell für Arbeitnehmer erkannt und revolutionieren dieses. Dabei helfen wir Unternehmen, ihre Mitarbeitenden vor und nach einer Krankheit zu unterstützen und mehr Zeit zu gewinnen. Unsere Versicherungslösungen reduzieren monotone und manuelle Tätigkeiten für Mitarbeitende, Ärzte sowie HR- und Payroll-Manager. Mit unserer digitalen Transformation stellen wir Mitarbeitende in den Mittelpunkt und gestalten die Zukunft der Versicherungsbranche.
 
Bei grape sind wir stolz auf unser ambitioniertes Team und unsere Unternehmenskultur. Wir wachsen schnell und hier bist du gefragt. Wir sind engagiert, dynamisch, vielfältig und voller kreativer Ideen. Willst du mit uns durchstarten? Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennen zu lernen!
 

Deine Rolle:

Als Claims Supporter:in in unserem internationalen Team bist du das Herzstück unseres Kundenservice. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Claims Managern zusammen, übernimmst wichtige First-Level-Aufgaben und gestaltest aktiv die Customer Journey mit. In unserem digitalen Umfeld bearbeitest du Schadensfälle effizient und kundenorientiert. Deine Expertise ist der Schlüssel zu einem nahtlosen und aussergewöhnlichen Kundenerlebnis. Wenn du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen, internationalen Setting zu arbeiten und die Zukunft der Versicherungsbranche mitzugestalten, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!


Dein Tätigkeitsbereich:
  • Professionelle Abwicklung administrativer Aufgaben, insbesondere die sorgfältige Vorbereitung und Bearbeitung von Schadensdokumenten unter strikter Einhaltung vorgegebener Richtlinien
  • Kompetente Betreuung der Kundenhotline: Bearbeitung ein- und ausgehender Anrufe, präzise Beantwortung von Kundenanfragen und effiziente Lösung von Problemen im Zusammenhang mit Schadensfällen
  • Verantwortungsvolle Koordination von Rechnungen für die Finanzabteilung sowie gewissenhafte Verwaltung und kontinuierliche Aktualisierung der Falldokumentation
  • Aktive Unterstützung des Claims-Teams bei diversen Aufgaben, insbesondere bei der Überprüfung von Zuständigkeiten und Deckungen für Schadensfälle sowie bei der Entwicklung von Case-Management-Strategien
  • Mitwirkung bei der Implementierung neuer technologischer Lösungen zur Optimierung der Claims-Support-Prozesse und Verbesserung interner Arbeitsabläufe
  • Beitrag zu Projekten im Bereich Prävention und Wiedereingliederung von Arbeitnehmern, um innovative Lösungen in diesem Bereich zu fördern und umzusetzen

    • Was du mitbringst:
  • Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Kundenservice der Versicherungsbranche
  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten für den Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen zu Partnern und zur Unterstützung von Mitarbeitern während ihrer Abwesenheit
  • Teamplayer-Mentalität mit der Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Startup-Umfeld zu arbeiten und sich flexibel an wechselnde Prioritäten anzupassen
  • Technische Affinität und grosses Interesse an der Nutzung neuer Technologien zur Verbesserung von Claims-Support-Prozessen
  • Fähigkeit zum selbstständigen und präzisen Arbeiten bei der Bewältigung vielfältiger Aufgaben
  • Engagement für die Erforschung innovativer Ansätze zur Prävention und Wiedereingliederung von Mitarbeitern ins Arbeitsleben
  • Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse (C1-Niveau); Von Vorteil: Englisch-, Französisch und/oder Italienischkenntnisse
    • 🤝 Was wir bieten:
    🌱 Motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld: Werde Teil eines engagierten Teams und eines Umfelds, das Eigenverantwortung fördert. Du erhältst das Vertrauen, die Tools und den Rückhalt, um Entscheidungen zu treffen und Ideen umzusetzen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir Lösungen, die wirklich etwas bewegen.
    💻 Hybrides Setup: Profitiere von der Flexibilität unseres hybriden Arbeitsmodells – arbeite remote oder in unserem Büro in Zürich. Donnerstags, an unserem Teamtag, treffen wir uns gemeinsam im Zürcher Büro.
    🪑 Home-Office-Pauschale: Für dein Home Office stellen wir dir einmalig CHF 200.– zur Verfügung, damit du dir deinen Arbeitsplatz zu Hause so einrichten kannst, wie er für dich passt.
    🌐 Internetpauschale: Du bekommst von uns jeden Monat einen Zuschuss für deine Internetkosten, damit du auch von zu Hause aus problemlos arbeiten kannst.
    ⏳Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du kannst deine Arbeitszeit nach deinen Bedürfnissen gestalten.
    🧠 Lernbudget: Wir unterstützen dich dabei, deine Fähigkeiten zu verbessern, neues Wissen zu erlangen und deine Karriere voranzutreiben. Dafür stellen wir dir ein jährliches Budget von CHF 1’500.- zur Verfügung.
    ❤️‍🩹 Wohlbefinden: Eine gute Work-Life-Balance ist uns wichtig. Wir schaffen ein unterstützendes Umfeld und bieten z. B. Mental-Health-Sessions und Vergünstigungen, um dein Wohlbefinden zu fördern.
    🎫 Teamevents: Jeden Monat kommen wir bei abwechslungsreichen und inspirierenden Events zusammen, um uns auszutauschen und das Miteinander zu stärken.
    ✈️ Team-Retreats: Einmal im Jahr reisen wir gemeinsam an einen schönen Ort – eine besondere Gelegenheit, um gemeinsam Zeit zu verbringen und als Team noch enger zusammenzuwachsen.
    🚂 Reisen & Pendeln: Wir übernehmen deine SBB-Halbtax, damit du entspannt ins Büro kommst.
    🌴Bezahlter Urlaub: Du erhältst 5 Wochen (25 Tage) bezahlten Urlaub pro Jahr sowie 2 zusätzliche Urlaubstage als Ausgleich für kantonale Feiertage, religiöse Feiertage, Geburtstage o. Ä. Insgesamt stehen dir 27 bezahlte Urlaubstage pro Jahr zur Verfügung.
    🧖‍♀️ Wellness-Budget: Weil Wohlbefinden für jede*n etwas anderes bedeutet, stellen wir dir ein flexibles Budget zur Verfügung, das du nach deinen Bedürfnissen nutzen kannst.
    👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Elternzeit & Adoptionsurlaub: Wir bieten zusätzliche freie Tage, um dich in den wichtigsten Phasen deines Familienlebens zu unterstützen.
    ✈️ Digitales Nomadentum: Nach jeweils 3 Jahren bei uns kannst du für einen längeren Zeitraum aus dem Ausland arbeiten (nach Prüfung des Standorts).
     
     
     
    🏁 Unser Rekrutierungsprozess:
     
    Bei unserer Auswahlentscheidung achten wir besonders auf vier Bereiche: fachliche und technische Kompetenzen, Mindset & Werte, und wir bewerten diese in den folgenden Schritten:
     
    Schritt 1 - Deine Motivation
    Damit wir uns besser kennenlernen können, laden wir dich zu einem 30-minütigen Motivationsgespräch mit unserem Talent Acquisition Team ein
    Schritt 2 - Rollfit
    Im ersten Interview prüfen wir gemeinsam, wie gut deine Qualifikationen und Kompetenzen zu den Anforderungen der Rolle passen. Dieses Gespräch führst du mit deinem potenziellen Hiring Manager
    Schritt 3 - Case Study
    Falls die Rolle eine höhere technische Anforderung beinhaltet, laden wir dich zu einer Fallstudie oder einem technischen Assessment ein. So können wir deine spezifischen Fähigkeiten und dein Lösungsdenken noch besser einschätzen
    Schritt 4 - Unsere Unternehmenskultur
    In einem weiteren Gespräch lernst du mehr über unsere Unternehmenskultur und wir prüfen, wie gut deine Werte und dein Mindset zu unserem Unternehmen passen.
    Unsere vielfältigen Erfahrungen, Perspektiven und Stimmen machen uns zu dem Unternehmen, das wir sind, und wir würden gerne mehr über dich erfahren!

data.description:
🍇 About grape: 
 
Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.
 
At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role:

Hi there. Janine here. I know, this is unconventional… I'm deviating from the regular job description script. Why? Because this role is different. The starting point for this role is different. And we want to communicate that clearly.

If you browse our website and think, "amazing opportunity for a rebrand", we are not for you. Because here's the truth: what you just saw isn't a draft. It's not a v1. It's the result of a year spent getting the fundamentals right and building a visual foundation we believe in for the long term. What you saw is the floor, not the ceiling. It's the minimum bar for anything we ship from here on out. No rebrand. No reset. Just continuous improvement.

We're now at the point where we're looking to build up in-house design, and we need someone who can put the brand before personal signature, buy into what you just saw, execute on it with the same care it was built with, and then, over the years, shape its trajectory and help develop it further.

Who are you designing for, you ask? Three very different audiences: HR, the CFO, and, most importantly, the insured person. Not the easiest of brief, since most of the industry still talks to people like they're a policy number, especially at their hardest moments. We want to change that. This is why your work matters so much. At every touchpoint. You're not just making things look good. You're deciding what it feels like to face this system on a day when someone has less capacity than usual to deal with it.

That's the job: breathe life into our brand with your design skills and branding expertise, ensuring we deliver high-quality design solutions that connect with our audiences, feel distinctively human, and feel distinctively us. 

The team, you ask?
At this stage of growth, most of us are generalists wearing many different hats each day. Outside of work, you might find us boating on the lake, snowboarding in Arosa, hiking in Appenzell, playing dress-up with our kids, or looking out the window in a classroom in Bern. A bunch of wonderful human beings, skilled in many different things in life. Each one is equally important in building this brand step by step, day by day.

P.S. No AI in the application process for this role! We look at every portfolio and read every cover letter. So, you are not wasting your time telling us why you want to join :)

Please add a link to your portfolio or attach it when applying.


What you’ll do:
  • Shape the brand story going forward.
  • Execute on our new visual identity and help sharpen our brand guidelines.
  • Lead design projects from concept through delivery.
  • Bring your creative expertise and know-how to campaign planning just as much as to execution.
  • Design and create digital and physical collateral for brand and marketing initiatives. 
  • Review design work from external partners to ensure high quality and brand consistency.

    • What you’ll need:
  • You bring +6 years of experience, either from a branding/ creative agency or working within an in-house team.
  • You have a proven track record of building brands, are able to adapt your designs to the respective brand, and are proficient at reviewing design materials to ensure cohesive execution.
  • You are equally skilled in creative direction and creative execution, taking ownership and occasionally working with freelancers to speed up the process.
  • Your strong aesthetic sensibility and passion for branding allow you to interpret the brand and deliver a unified narrative through your work.
  • You excel at managing a variety of design projects simultaneously, collaborating effectively with both internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • You are highly skilled in Figma and equally adept with Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop. After Effects is a plus.
  • Creating animated digital assets that are versatile and impactful is second nature to you.
  • You have an eye for detail, precision, and exceptional typography skills.
  • While you thrive working independently, you also enjoy partnering with diverse teams to bring projects and campaigns to life.
  • As a collaborator, you challenge others constructively while pushing your own creative boundaries.
  • You are fluent in English, both written and spoken, with German being a plus.

    • What you will learn:
  • Refine expertise in brand storytelling by working on diverse design projects that bring the grape brand’s vision to life across various platforms.
  • Expand skills in cross-functional collaboration through hands-on involvement with internal teams, external freelancers, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of creative initiatives.
  • Deepen proficiency in creating scalable design systems that support cohesive branding and elevate the user experience across digital and physical touchpoints.
  • Gain exposure to strategic branding challenges by contributing to high-impact projects and learning how to adapt designs to evolving business needs and audience expectations.
    • 🤝 What we offer in return:
    🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions.
    💻  Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office.
    🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home.
    🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office.
    ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to.
    🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually
    ❤️‍🩹  Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy.
    🎫  Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams.
    ✈️  Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues.
    🚂  Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office.
    🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days.
    🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs.
    👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life.
    ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review).
     
    🏁 Our recruitment process
    We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps:
     
    Step 1 - Your motivation
    To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team.
    Step 2 - Role fit
    In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager.
    Step 3 - Case study
    For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities.
    Step 4 - Our culture connect
    Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision.
     
    Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you!
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance.
    At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us.
    With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together.
    Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping Health at Heart, Inventing Together, and always striving to Embrace Clarity.

data.description:
Techwan, part of the Everbridge Group, develops mission-critical command and control systems used by emergency services, public safety agencies, and government organizations. Our technology helps customers respond faster, communicate effectively, and make confident decisions when it matters most.

 

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to build reliable, scalable, and automated platforms across customer and internal environments.

 

You’ll take ownership of platform standardization, deployment automation, and operational reliability, helping teams deploy critical applications efficiently and consistently. This is a hands-on role that include required on-call activity, with the opportunity to shape our platform roadmap and introduce new technologies and ways of working.


What you'll do:
  • Design and maintain platforms across Linux and Windows environments.
  • Build reusable deployment automation using Ansible.
  • Standardize platforms across internal and customer environments.
  • Improve provisioning, upgrades, migrations, testing, and lifecycle management.
  • Develop scalable and portable solutions using virtualization and container technologies.
  • Support application and database migrations while maintaining platform stability.
  • Integrate automated testing into deployment workflows.
  • Partner with Technical Project Managers, System Engineers, and the Program Manager.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation and share knowledge across the team.
  • Support critical customer deployments and participate in a shared out-of-hours on-call rotation.
  • Depending on experience, help define platform architecture, mentor colleagues, and lead automation initiatives.

What you'll bring:
  • Strong experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure automation.
  • Hands-on experience supporting production environments.
  • Advanced Linux knowledge and good Windows Server/IIS experience.
  • Strong Ansible expertise—this is essential.
  • Shell and/or PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitLab, or TFS.
  • Good knowledge of Git and version-control workflows.
  • Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware, Proxmox, Hyper-V, or Incus.
    • Understanding of containers, high-availability architectures, load balancing, and networking fundamentals.
    • Basic SQL knowledge, ideally with PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
    • A proactive, collaborative approach with strong problem-solving, communication, and ownership skills.
    • Fluency in French (must have) & English (good to have)

Why join us?
  • Work on mission-critical technology with a genuine real-world impact.
  • Help shape the future of our platform engineering capability.
  • Enjoy a flexible, remote-first working environment.
  • Collaborate on international projects with significant autonomy and ownership.

    •  

#LI-HG1
 
About Everbridge 
Everbridge empowers enterprises and government organizations to anticipate, mitigate, respond to and recover stronger from critical events. In today’s unpredictable world, resilient organizations minimize impact to people and operations, absorb stress, and return to productivity faster when deploying critical event management (CEM) technology. Everbridge digitizes organizational resilience by combining intelligent automation with the industry’s most comprehensive risk data to Keep People Safe and Organizations Running™. For more information, visit our website, read the company blog, and follow us on social media. 
 
Everbridge… Empowering Resilience.  Everbridge is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.
